body.x: JABRA unveiled its a Bluetooth earphone, ‘ELITE65t’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

JABRA designs world-class audio solutions for calls and music. This solution improves the productivity of open office and meets fitness requirements in motion. At this CES 2018, it was ‘ELITE 65t’ and ELITE 65t is a cordless earphone that supports voice recognition feature such as Alexa, Google assistant, and Siri. In addition, it has a function of wind noise reduction, ambient sound blockage and inflow.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
